why_this_rate: The rate the other whole-type models of this unit are drawn at. The canceller's delay is fitted in whole samples of it, and the interaural delays are fractions of a sample read by linear interpolation.
what_varies: One source, the two inputs summed; per ear a spherical head's delay and shadow and a front-back cue -- a low pass crossfaded in and a level, both growing with the angle off the front and the same in both ears -- and the speaker rendering cancels crosstalk on the side signal alone and leaves the mid as it is. Fitted on the azimuth sweep's takes against the bypassed takes beside them: 2.26 dB rms over the phones bands and 3.53 dB over the speaker bands.
